comment: THE SPARK CLICKER — a side minigame of its own, unlocked by the Arcade Cabinet node in the Ascend Tree. Click for Sparks, spend Sparks on the upgrades below. Everything here is tunable: costs, cost growth, caps, effects, crit rules, auto-click pacing. The upgrades that matter most are the ones that feed back into the real game — `luck` multiplies your main-game Luck and `cooldown` cuts your roll cooldown — the rest just make the clicking itself stronger. Permanent: ascending never resets your Sparks or your upgrades. Its own RNG for crits, exactly like the shaft has its own for ore.
comment_click: clickCooldownMs is the server-side floor between two manual clicks — it stops a scripted browser clicking 500 times a second, it is not meant to slow a real hand. maxClicksPerTap caps how many clicks one tap may resolve into, so a huge Clicks/Click number can never be used to smuggle a giant payout through one request.
comment_crit: Every click rolls its own crit from these numbers. critChance upgrades add to baseChance (never past maxChance), critMult upgrades add to baseMult. A crit pays critMult × the click.
comment_auto: Auto clicks are banked server-side from real elapsed time, so they cannot be faked by spamming the endpoint. maxBankedMs caps how much time one tick may account for (a tab asleep for an hour pays an hour, not a week); maxClicksPerTick bounds a single response.
comment_effects: Effect types the upgrades below can use. `fmt` is only how the client words the label: pct → +N%, flat → +N. luck / cooldown / essenceMult / sellMult / mineMult are main-game bonuses and stack with the Ascend Tree and your gear; the click* ones stay inside the minigame.

comment_upgrades: Cost of the next level = floor(baseCost * growth^levelOwned). max: 0 means unlimited. Ordered cheap → expensive, clicker-local first, the main-game bonuses after — that order is what the shop renders.
